detail.title: Mechanical Accountability in WAKE Architecture
detail.summary: WAKE✳︎ ensures accountability by delegating authority to a deterministic governance module that rejects unauthorized proposal transitions, while the research layer provides structured, bounded access to external evidence, preventing the system from bypassing its own constraints.
